title: Product Design Director - Patient (x/f/m)
description:
Product Design Director - Patient (x/f/m) 

The opportunity 

Doctolib is a mission-driven healthcare technology company, founded in Paris in 2013. Today, nearly 3,000 people work across Europe to transform the way healthcare is delivered and experienced.

More than 500,000 healthcare professionals use Doctolib’s solutions, and the patient app is used by approximately 90 million people across Europe.

For patients, Doctolib began as a simple way to find a healthcare professional and book an appointment. We are now building something much more ambitious: an AI-powered Health Companion that helps people navigate care, understand their health and take the right next step throughout their health journey.

This means moving beyond a primarily transactional product towards an experience that supports patients before, during and after care, through access to care, health information, patient data, messaging, recommendations, care plans and AI-powered assistance.

We are looking for a Product Design Director to help define what this next generation of patient experience should look and feel like.

What you will build and lead 

As Product Design Director, Patient , you will own the design vision and quality bar for Doctolib’s patient experience. You will report to our VP Design and work closely with the Product, Engineering, Medical, Data and Business leadership teams. 

Your scope will cover the full patient journey, including:

- access to care, search and booking;

- patient messaging and teleconsultation;

- the Patient Health Record and patient context;

- the app homepage and daily health experience;

- health content and prevention;

- recommendations, reminders and care plans;

- new patient services and subscription experiences;

- conversational and AI-powered experiences.

The current team includes six Senior Product Designers and one Senior Content Designer . You will lead, coach and develop this team while shaping the organisation and operating model needed to support the next phase of the Patient product.

Your mandate 

You will:

- Define and drive the design vision for the Patient stream, from a high-traffic booking experience to a trusted Health Companion used throughout the health journey.

- Bridge two equally important challenges: continuing to improve the core access-to-care experience while creating new reasons for patients to return beyond booking.

- Raise the quality bar for product design, interaction design and content across the patient experience.

- Stay close enough to the product and the craft to make high-quality design decisions, not only set direction from a distance.

- Shape AI-native experiences that are clear, useful and trustworthy, including recommendations, conversational interfaces and next-best actions.

- Establish strong design principles for transparency, explainability, uncertainty, user control and safe escalation in a healthcare context.

- Build a high-performing design organisation, including hiring, coaching, talent development and second-line leadership.

- Create effective ways of working across Design, Product, Engineering, Medical, Data and Business.

- Help scale a coherent experience across countries, languages and different healthcare contexts.

- Connect design decisions to user behaviour, product outcomes and business impact.

What success looks like 

In your first year, you will have:

- established a clear and compelling design vision for the Patient stream;

- raised the quality bar across both core access-to-care journeys and newer Health Companion experiences;

- helped define a coherent interaction model for AI-powered patient experiences;

- strengthened collaboration between Design, Product, Engineering and Medical;

- developed a clear operating model and growth plan for the Patient Design organisation;

- helped Doctolib increase the value and relevance of the patient experience beyond appointment booking.

What we are looking for 

You are likely to bring:

- Significant experience leading Product Design, 10+ years in product design including 3+ years in people leadership..

- Experience in a consumer product organisation, ideally one used by millions of people.

- A track record of designing and scaling products across multiple markets, with an understanding of localisation, cultural differences and the balance between global consistency and local relevance.

- Experience managing at least five Product Designers, ideally a larger organisation including senior individual contributors and managers.

- Strong product design craft and creative judgement. You can recognise excellent work, make difficult quality trade-offs and stay close enough to the details to raise the standard of the product.

- Experience connecting design choices to measurable outcomes such as adoption, conversion, engagement, retention, satisfaction or user behaviour.

- A strong and practical understanding of AI-native product experiences. You have thought deeply about how AI changes interaction design, user expectations, trust, transparency and control.

- Experience designing with uncertainty, recommendations, personalisation or conversational interfaces is highly relevant.

- The ability to operate across complex products and stakeholders, while maintaining clarity and momentum.

- A concise and compelling communication style. You can articulate a clear point of view, align senior stakeholders and inspire teams to move in a new direction.

- Experience in healthcare or another regulated, trust-sensitive environment is valuable, but healthcare experience is not required. What matters is your respect for domain expertise and your ability to design responsibly in high-stakes contexts.

- Fluency in English. French or German would be a strong plus.

- A working style aligned with the Doctolib Playbook: User First, Medical Expertise, Forefront of Innovation, Bold, Drive, Passion, Humility.

Why Doctolib, why now? 

Doctolib gives you the opportunity to work on a consumer product with significant reach, strong European scale and a mission that matters.

The patient product already has a large and engaged audience. The next challenge is to make the experience more useful, more contextual and more present in people’s everyday health journeys.

You will join at a defining moment:

- Doctolib is moving from appointment booking towards continuous health support.

- AI is becoming a core part of the product experience, not an isolated feature.

- The Patient Design organisation is being strengthened and reshaped.

- The product must work across multiple European countries, languages and healthcare systems.

- The design foundations for the next chapter are still being built.

This is an opportunity to shape a new category at the intersection of consumer product design, healthcare and AI , and to define how people will discover, understand and manage their health in the future.

title: Senior Backend Engineer
description:
We’re a team of experts pushing the limits of what’s possible, united by our common goal to unlock true freedom through digital ownership, making technology accessible for all. Our mission is simple: to make self-custody accessible and give people the keys to their own financial futures. If you want to make a true impact, we want you to join us at Ledger.

At Ledger, we’re proud to be the global platform for digital assets and Web3, with over 20% of the world’s crypto assets secured through our Ledger devices. With our headquarters in Paris, and offices in Vierzon, Grenoble, Montpellier, London, Portland, Geneva, Zurich and Central Singapore, we have a team of around 600 professionals developing a variety of products and services to enable individuals and companies to securely buy, store, swap, grow and manage crypto assets – including the Ledger hardware wallets line with more than 7.5 millions units already sold in 200 countries. 

The team 

To sustain the company's growth, Ledger is looking for a Senior Scala Backend Engineer to join the Cloud Wallet team . This team builds and operates the backend services that power blockchain account management, transaction processing and on-chain data aggregation across all Ledger wallet surfaces, from Ledger Live to Ledger Enterprise, the custody platform used by financial institutions. Every client transaction goes through these services, and so does every new blockchain Ledger supports. We believe in the power of functional programming to build robust and scalable platforms. We take time to share, challenge, and grow together through bi-weekly knowledge-sharing sessions, meetups, conferences, and open source contributions.

What you’ll be doing 

- Design, build and operate the Scala services that connect Ledger wallets and the Ledger Enterprise platform to blockchain backends: account creation, operation history, transaction crafting, broadcast and lifecycle tracking.

- Lead new blockchain integrations end to end, from the integration design (ADR) to production, across account-based, UTXO and privacy-preserving chains.

- Own production quality on your scope: SLIs and SLOs, observability, distributed tracing. Take part in the firefighting rotation and drive incidents to resolution, including those raised by institutional clients.

- Define clear contracts with the Coin Integration and Ledger Enterprise teams, for example where UTXO selection lives or how transaction states are exposed to consumers.

- Write and review ADRs, challenge designs, and raise the bar on code quality, testing (including end-to-end on testnets) and technical debt management.

- Work in an AI-native way: use coding agents daily, write the specifications, constraints and verification that let them deliver safely, and contribute to the team's AI tooling.

- Mentor other engineers and share your knowledge across the Backend Blockchain community.

You will collaborate cross-functionally with: 

- The Coin Integration team for coin modules and new blockchain integrations.

- The Ledger Enterprise team, main consumer of the team's services for institutional custody.

- The Ledger Wallet, Ledger Button and Wallet XP teams as consumers of the team's backend APIs.

- The Blockchain platform team for data model alignment, indexing and event streaming.

- The Infrastructure and SRE teams for deployment, reliability and scalability.

- The Security team (Donjon) for vulnerability analysis and remediation.

- The Product team for roadmap prioritization and customer-driven requirements.

What we’re looking for 

- 5+ years of backend engineering, with real production ownership of distributed systems.

- Strong production experience

- Interest for Scala and functional programming practice

- Hands-on blockchain integration experience: transaction lifecycle, fees, finality, reorgs, on at least two models among account-based, UTXO and privacy-preserving chains.

- Experience with event-driven systems and data infrastructure (PostgreSQL, RabbitMQ, NATS or equivalent) and with observability tooling (Datadog or equivalent).

- Able to diagnose an incident across several services and own the outcome, from root cause to fix in production.

- Comfortable reading and contributing to TypeScript code, as the team works on a polyglot stack.

- Daily use of AI coding tools, with a critical eye on their output.

title: Senior Platform Engineer
description:
Join Pigment: The AI Platform Redefining Business Planning 

Pigment is the AI-powered business planning and performance management platform built for agility and scale. We connect people, data, and processes in one intuitive, feature-rich solution, empowering every team—from Finance to HR—to build, adapt, and align strategic plans in real time. 

Founded in 2019, Pigment is one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies globally. Industry leaders like Unilever, Snowflake, Siemens, and DPD use Pigment daily to make more informed decisions and confidently navigate any scenario. 

With a team of 600+ across Paris, London, New York, Toronto, San Francisco and Austin, we've raised nearly $400M from top-tier investors and were named a Visionary in the 2024 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Financial Planning Software. 

At Pigment, we take smart risks, celebrate bold ideas, and challenge the status quo—all while working as one team. If you're driven by innovation and ready to make an impact at scale, we’d love to hear from you. 

The opportunity 

We are looking for a Senior Platform Engineer profile who will design and implement the Pigment infrastructure for tomorrow. Pigment is a technically challenging platform. It calculates and synchronizes large datasets that must be updated in real-time. Data comes from client models that can be up to billions of rows. This data can be pivoted, transformed, and aggregated on-demand through our formula engine while rendering live on our front end.

Here are the challenges to be tackled as a Senior Platform Engineer:

- Define and build the infrastructure needed to answer our performance challenges, automate it, and make it scalable. In particular, ensure that the infrastructure scales in and out according to the platform usage.

- Secure high availability and redundancy of the Pigment platform.

- Ensure that the platform’s performance and correctness are monitored accordingly, spread observability best practices across the engineering team.

- Participate in incident response.

- Accompany Pigment geographical expansion as the company grows and we sign clients overseas.

- Work with our security team on the implementation of their roadmap when related to infrastructure and development pipelines (code repository, credentials management, ...)

- Continuously chase inefficiencies within our development practices and pipelines. Seek improvement and automation wherever possible. Drive change across the software engineering team.

In addition to Platform responsibilities, we expect you to contribute to software development activities. This is not limited to scripting and automations - we expect to you to be fully capable of reading and writing code. We believe Senior Platform Engineers should collaborate closely with software engineers, fostering a shared understanding of day-to-day challenges, rather than operating in separate teams. Last but not least, you will not be alone! You will be part of an SRE team.

Our Engineering team 

Our Engineering team is responsible for developing our SaaS platform and building a comprehensive and user-friendly product.

Pigment engineers participate in the entire application development lifecycle, focusing on design, coding, and keeping the production platform up and running. They can be specialized, but there is no strict separation between the infrastructure, backend, and the frontend.

We value user-centricity and pragmatism: we choose the most relevant tools for the problem we have to solve, understanding the strengths and constraints of each technology.

Our engineering culture also values curiosity, humility, trust, ownership and team spirit.

Technical stack: 

- Kubernetes (GKE, hosted on Google Cloud Platform): hosting all our infrastructure components except some PostgreSQL hosts, hosted on Google Cloud SQL

- Terraform: all our infrastructure is managed via this infrastructure as code (creation of GKE clusters, Google Cloud SQL databases, GCS buckets, IAM permissions...)

- Databases: PostgreSQL (CloudSQL and CloudNativePG), SingleStore, ElasticSearch

- RabbitMQ: queuing system

- Temporal.io: workflow automation platform

- Others: ArgoCD, Istio, Vault, Github, Docker (for local development)

- Backend: Microservices written in C# ASP.NET Core 8 (running exclusively on Linux) & Golang

- Frontend: React + Typescript, Jest, Cypress, Vite...

Who you are 

More than knowledge of a specific cloud provider, language, or automation framework, we are looking for great engineering skills : the ability to translate product requirements into an elegant and simple architecture, and then make sure our product runs well on it.

In any case, you have:

- Experience as a software engineer & Platform Engineer. Hands on coding is a must for this role.

- Experience with a container orchestration platform (Kubernetes is a plus)

- Experience with a public cloud provider, GCP is a plus

- Proven experience in software developments with languages such as C#, Java, C++, Golang, Rust, JavaScript, Python, or Ruby (this list is not exhaustive).

- Experience with observability tools (e.g. Datadog, Prometheus, ELK, Jaeger...)

- Great team spirit with a problem-solving attitude.

- A good dose of humility and the willingness to grow (no matter your seniority!).

- Fluency in English

title: Single Photon Source Lithography Engineer
description:
Quandela is a global leader in quantum computing, designing, building, and delivering cutting-edge quantum solutions for research and industry. Its offerings include the most energy-efficient quantum computers for data centers, full-stack quantum computing solutions accessible via the cloud, and algorithm access services for academic and industrial customers. Following a pragmatic, step-by-step roadmap, Quandela has been deploying industrial-grade systems since 2023 while developing future generations of fault-tolerant quantum computers capable of scaling through the integration of thousands of photonic components. Quandela is committed to making quantum computing accessible to all in order to address the most complex industrial and societal challenges. 
Learn more at: Quandela | Leading Photonic Quantum Computing Solutions 

About this position: 

Role Overview 

We are looking for a Single Photon Source Lithography Engineer to support the development, stabilization and industrialization of our semiconductor fabrication processes. 

At our current stage of maturity, this position combines advanced process development, hands-on R&D and manufacturing engineering. The Lithography Engineer will play a key role in bridging the gap between Advanced R&D and Production, transforming newly developed process building blocks into robust, repeatable and scalable manufacturing processes. 

The role will have a strong focus on in-situ localization of quantum dots (QDs) at cryogenic temperatures and laser lithography over the localized Qds with laser writing techniques. The successful candidate will work closely with R&D teams, fabrication engineers, equipment owners and cleanroom operators to improve process capability, reproducibility, yield and production throughput. 

This is a highly hands-on position requiring a strong understanding of semiconductor fabrication, rigorous experimental methodology and the ability to investigate complex interactions between process parameters and device performance. 

Key Responsibilities 

Process Development & Industrialization 

- Develop, optimize and stabilize QD positioning and laser lithography process. 
- Contribute to the development of GUIs and automation codes in the Python programming language. 
- Contrinute to the development of fully-automated QD-positioning and litography tools. 
- Validate and qualify new fabrication equipment and associated processes. 
- Define process windows, recipes, operating conditions and acceptance criteria. 
- Use structured experimentation, including Design of Experiments (DoE) where appropriate, to understand process sensitivities and optimize performance. 
- Improve process repeatability, reproducibility, robustness and within-wafer / wafer-to-wafer homogeneity. 
- Prepare processes and equipment for increasing wafer sizes, batch sizes and production volumes. 
R&D to Production Transfer 

- Act as a key technical interface between Advanced R&D and Production. 
- Convert R&D process building blocks into stable, documented and manufacturable processes. 
- Assess manufacturability, scalability and process risks before transfer to production. 
- Define qualification plans and acceptance criteria before releasing new or modified processes to production. 
- Lead or contribute to Process Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (PFMEA) for critical fabrication steps, identifying potential failure modes, their effects on device performance and appropriate prevention and control measures. 
- Translate PFMEA outcomes into process controls, monitoring plans, acceptance criteria, Control Plans and documentation. 
- Support technology transfer through clear documentation, operator training and technical communication. 
Process Control & Yield Improvement 

- Monitor and improve production process performance, yield and throughput. 
- Establish regular process checks, controls and monitoring methodologies, including Statistical Process Control (SPC) where relevant. 
- Detect process drifts, investigate deviations and define corrective and preventive actions. 
- Lead root-cause analysis and troubleshooting activities for yield losses, process excursions and equipment-related issues. 
- Define and maintain relevant process KPIs and contribute to continuous-improvement initiatives. 
- Promote best practices that increase process stability, repeatability and equipment utilization. 
Equipment & Production Support 

- Provide hands-on technical support to cleanroom operators and production teams. 
- Work closely with equipment suppliers and internal teams to resolve technical issues. 
- Contribute to a safe, disciplined and efficient cleanroom environment. 
Process Characterization & Data Analysis 

- Correlate process data with structural, optical and electrical characterization results. 
- Use experimental data to identify process sensitivities, failure mechanisms and optimization opportunities. 
- Develop appropriate data-analysis tools to support process monitoring and engineering decisions. 
- Search and analyze scientific and technical literature to support process development and troubleshooting. 
Documentation & Communication 

- Create and maintain high-quality process documentation, including process specifications, Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), equipment recipes, qualification reports, Control Plans, process-development reports and troubleshooting guides. 
- Ensure frequent and clear reporting of process status, experimental results, risks and improvement actions. 
- Communicate effectively with colleagues from different technical backgrounds and levels of experience. 
- Train and support operators and other team members on new or updated processes. 

Requirements 

Required Qualifications & Experience 

- Master's degree or PhD in Optics, Materials Science, Physics, Micro/Nanotechnology, Electrical Engineering, or a related field. 
- Hands-on experience with semiconductor or photonic-device fabrication in a cleanroom environment. 
- Hands-on experience in conception, assembling, and alignment of optical systems. 
- Hands-on experience in conception, assembling, and operation of electronic devices 
- Python programming language fluency. 
- Excellent attention to detail and a rigorous approach to experimental work. 
- Strong troubleshooting, root-cause analysis and problem-solving skills. 
- Ability to independently investigate technical problems using experimental data and scientific literature. 
- Strong communication and documentation skills. 
- Fluent English, both written and spoken. 
Preferred Qualifications 

- Experience in developments of GUIs with the python programming language. 
- Experience in a semiconductor manufacturing, pilot-line or production environment. 
- Experience with process industrialization and transfer from R&D to production. 
- Experience with PFMEA, Control Plans, SPC, DoE or other structured process-risk and continuous-improvement methodologies. 
- Experience with III-V semiconductor devices, particularly AlGaAs-based photonic structures, resonators or VCSEL-type technologies. 
Profile

title: Senior Project Manager - Quantum Research
description:
Quandela is a global leader in quantum computing, designing, building, and delivering cutting-edge quantum solutions for research and industry. Its offerings include the most energy-efficient quantum computers for data centers, full-stack quantum computing solutions accessible via the cloud, and algorithm access services for academic and industrial customers. Following a pragmatic, step-by-step roadmap, Quandela has been deploying industrial-grade systems since 2023 while developing future generations of fault-tolerant quantum computers capable of scaling through the integration of thousands of photonic components. Quandela is committed to making quantum computing accessible to all in order to address the most complex industrial and societal challenges. Learn more at: Quandela | Leading Photonic Quantum Computing Solutions 

About the Role 

We are looking for an experienced Senior Project Manager – Advanced Technology Programs to lead large-scale, strategic technology and R&D programs involving multiple technical disciplines, internal teams and external partners.

You will operate at the intersection of technology, engineering and program execution , turning ambitious technical objectives into structured and executable programs.

You will coordinate programs involving disciplines such as quantum physics, integrated photonics, semiconductor technologies, electronics, optics, hardware engineering, software and algorithms , while ensuring alignment between technical performance, schedule, resources, budget and contractual commitments.

We are particularly interested in candidates who have managed large and technically complex programs in demanding engineering environments such as space, aerospace, defense or semiconductors , where successful delivery requires coordinating multidisciplinary teams, suppliers, industrial partners, research organizations and institutional stakeholders across several countries.

This is a senior individual contributor / program leadership position requiring both technical credibility and strong execution capabilities . You will not be expected to be the scientific expert on every topic, but you must be able to understand complex technical dependencies, challenge assumptions, structure decisions and create the conditions for engineering teams to deliver.

Key responsabilities 

** Lead Complex Technology Projects 

Take end-to-end ownership of strategic R&D and technology projects, from initial framing through development, integration, validation and final delivery.

Translate high-level scientific, product or business ambitions into clear program objectives, work packages, milestones, interfaces and measurable deliverables .

Develop and maintain integrated project plans covering scope, schedule, resources, budget, dependencies and critical paths.

Establish program governance and ensure effective decision-making across technical teams and senior stakeholders.

Monitor progress against milestones and proactively identify deviations, bottlenecks and dependencies requiring management attention.

Drive recovery plans when projects deviate from their original objectives, including prioritization, resource reallocation, scope adjustment or technical replanning.

** Manage Technical complexity & interfaces 

Coordinate multidisciplinary teams spanning quantum physics, photonics, semiconductor technologies, optics, electronics, mechanical engineering, systems engineering, software and algorithms .

Work closely with technical leads to identify critical interfaces and dependencies between subsystems and workstreams.

Challenge project assumptions and ensure that technical decisions are translated into clear consequences for performance, schedule, cost and risk .

Support the transition from research and scientific proof-of-concept to engineering development, prototyping, integration, qualification and demonstrators .

Ensure that technical maturity, integration readiness and project risks are visible and understood at program level.

* * Coordinate Internal & External Stakeholders 

Act as a central coordination point between Quandela teams, industrial partners, suppliers, research institutions and institutional stakeholders.

Lead technical and programmatic exchanges involving stakeholders with different scientific, engineering and business perspectives.

Coordinate activities across multiple teams, organizations, sites and countries , ensuring clear ownership and effective information flow.

Manage expectations and commitments with external partners while protecting Quandela's technical, contractual and strategic interests.

Prepare and lead program reviews, steering committees and executive-level project updates.

** Risk, Budget & Delivery Management 

Establish and maintain structured risk and opportunity management , including technical, schedule, supply-chain, financial and organizational risks.

Own or contribute to program budgets, resource forecasts and capacity planning.

Define and monitor relevant KPIs covering delivery, technical maturity, cost, schedule and risk.

Anticipate critical-path issues and implement mitigation plans before they impact major milestones.

Create a strong culture of accountability, transparency and fact-based decision-making across programs.

** Governance, contracts & compliance 

Ensure high-quality program documentation, traceability and reporting. Coordinate contractual deliverables and reporting for strategic partnerships and publicly funded programs where applicable.

Work with relevant internal stakeholders on IP, confidentiality, export-control, security and contractual matters .

Contribute to improving Quandela's project and program management methodologies as the organization scales.

Requirements 

Education

You have graduated from a top-tier engineering school or university in engineering, physics or another relevant scientific or technical discipline.

A PhD in physics, photonics, quantum technologies, semiconductor technologies or a related engineering field is a strong asset , particularly when combined with substantial industrial program-management experience.

Experience

You bring approximately 10+ years of professional experience , including significant responsibility for complex technology or engineering programs.

You have demonstrated experience leading large-scale, multidisciplinary projects with significant technical complexity, multiple interfaces and demanding delivery objectives.

Experience in one or several of the following industries is particularly relevant:

- Space / aerospace
- Defense
- Semiconductors / microelectronics
- Advanced photonics or optics
- Complex scientific instrumentation
- Other high-tech environments combining hardware, software and advanced engineering
You have worked with multidisciplinary and international stakeholders , including engineering teams, scientists, suppliers, industrial partners, research institutions and/or public organizations.

You can demonstrate concrete examples of programs for which you managed significant scope, budget, resources, milestones, risks and external dependencies .

Technical & Program Management Capabilities

You have sufficient technical depth to understand complex engineering discussions, challenge project assumptions and identify critical technical dependencies without replacing subject-matter experts.

You are comfortable managing projects from early-stage R&D through engineering development, prototyping, integration and validation .

You have strong command of project/program management practices including WBS, planning, critical-path management, risk management, resource planning, budget management, change management and project governance .

Experience with PMI/PMP, PRINCE2, Agile or hybrid methodologies is valued, but demonstrated delivery experience matters more than certification alone. 

Experience with publicly funded, governmental or collaborative R&D programs is an advantage.

Previous quantum-computing experience is not mandatory . Experience in quantum technologies, photonics or semiconductor technologies would nevertheless be a strong asset.

Leadership & Mindset

You combine a strong engineering mindset with the ability to operate at program and strategic level. You are comfortable challenging senior technical stakeholders while maintaining constructive and fact-based discussions.

You know how to bring structure to environments where technical uncertainty is high and not all answers are available at the beginning of a project .

You can distinguish between issues requiring deep technical investigation and those requiring pragmatic decisions to maintain momentum.

You communicate effectively with both highly specialized technical teams and executive stakeholders.

You are comfortable operating in an international, multidisciplinary and rapidly growing deeptech environment .

Professional fluency in English is required.

Benefits 

- Flexible working environment, with the position primarily based at our Massy (Paris-Saclay) office to support close collaboration with the teams. 
- Profit-sharing and a company savings plan.
- Annual sustainable mobility bonus for eco-friendly transport (e-bike, electric car).
- Fully covered health insurance (Alan).
- Referral program (€1,000 for a junior and €2,000 for an experienced candidate)
- Subsidy for gym membership and sports activities (Gymlib).
- Meal subsidies (Swile).

Process 

- Talent Acquisition Interview (45')
- Hiring Managers Interviews (45' - 60')
- Reference checks
- Technical discussion and presentation of previous technical project management work
- Offer

Beyond That: 

At Quandela, we value intellectual diversity, curiosity and initiative. If you're passionate about quantum algorithms, fault-tolerant quantum computing and the future of large-scale quantum applications, we'd love to hear from you, even if you don't meet every listed requirement.

title: Associate Director, Regulatory & Pharmaceutical Affairs (Chief Pharmaceutical Officer Deputy)
description:
This senior pharmaceutical and regulatory position acts as the trusted right-hand partner (“bras droit”) to the Responsible Pharmacist (RP)/Chief Pharmaceutical Officer (CPO). Working in very close collaboration with the RP/CPO, the role supports the oversight, coordination, and execution of the company’s pharmaceutical responsibilities in France and provides continuity of leadership by acting as Deputy Chief Pharmaceutical Officer when required.

The position combines regulatory affairs, pharmaceutical quality, pharmacovigilance, promotional compliance, product supply oversight, and healthcare compliance. It requires both strategic judgment and strong operational involvement to ensure that the activities of the pharmaceutical establishment—particularly those associated with the exploitant status—are conducted in accordance with French and European requirements.

As a true extension of the RP/CPO, the role is expected to anticipate issues, provide sound recommendations, coordinate sensitive matters, and take ownership of key activities. When deputising for the RP/CPO, the incumbent assumes the relevant pharmaceutical responsibilities associated with the missions set out in Article R.5124-36 of the French Public Health Code.

This position is hybrid (onsite and remote working) and will be primarily located at Alnylam France offices in Paris.

Key Responsibilities 

- Participate in cross-functional regulatory initiatives within the affiliate, integrating perspectives from Commercial, Medical Affairs, Market Access, Quality, Supply Chain, Pharmacovigilance, and other relevant functions as assigned

- Facilitate effective collaboration between Regulatory, Medical, PV, Quality, and Commercial functions to identify and address potential compliance risks and ensure timely escalation and resolution of regulatory matters.

- Provide regulatory guidance on product information, promotional and non-promotional materials, medical/scientific communications, and other company information concerning medicinal products, ensuring alignment with approved product information and applicable legal requirements.

- Lead the regulatory review of promotional documents, as the non-promotional elements (institutional and environmental elements) to ensure that they are non-promotional working in partnership with internal groups and external Regulatory partners if necessary

- Act as the local French regulatory lead for assigned products, if necessary (ensuring local execution of the global strategy related to centralized procedure presdcription products, and/or development activities related to clinical studies etc. as needed)

- Regarding Pharmacovigilance activities, ensure local reconciliation activities, manage activities related to the approval of educational materials, and can act as LSO or LSO deputy

- Collaborate with the Responsible Pharmacist (RP)/Chief Pharmaceutical Officer (CPO) in the treatment of quality defects and any alert relating to the quality of batches, leading to a batch recall/withdrawal if necessary

- Contribute to the follow-up and processing of distribution/service complaints in concertation with the supply chain

- Supervise the monitoring of supplies of marketed products to ensure appropriate and continuous supply

- Contribute to the evaluation of product quality reviews (PQR) and ensure the follow-up of corrective and preventive measures described in the PQR and related to the performance of the manufacturing process and the storage conditions of the products

- Manage the implementation of process reviews and the pharmaceutical quality management system (QMS) in order to respond to regulatory changes and contribute to the operations inherent to the business

- Support activities regarding the Chart for promotional information, audit of subcontractors

- Support activities regarding compliance or relations with Healthcare Professionals and anti-gift law

- Build and maintain strong partnerships with external consultants, CROs, regulatory service providers, industry stakeholders, and relevant authorities to advance regulatory objectives and ensure appropriate local regulatory compliance.

- As a Chief Pharmaceutical Officer Deputy, ensures compliance of the missions as described in art. R.5124-36 of the French Public Health Code when acting to replace the RP/CPO

- Promote a culture of regulatory compliance, transparency, and responsible communication of medicinal-product information across the affiliate

Qualifications 

Required

- PharmD with relevant experience registered with “Ordre des Pharmaciens” (section B)

- Extensive knowledge and at least 7 years of experience of country-specific French/European Regulatory requirements for innovative products in late-stage development and post-approval

- Sound knowledge and experience of French and European Regulatory Affairs and associated requirements, specifically with prescription medicines and Centralized procedure

- Prior relevant knowledge and experience related to the activities related to the “exploitant”

- Established knowledge and at least 5 years of experience in promotional activities and capabilities to intecact with the medical affairs and marketing/commercial teams, as well as the French Competent Authorities

- Experience with working closely with ANSM and an excellent track record of building relationships with and influencing Regulatory Agencies

- Must be able and willing to work in a high-visibility, fast-paced environment. Must be flexible, detail-oriented, and possess good analytical and problem-solving skills

- Role entails particularly close and continuous collaboration with the RP/CPO, built on trust, transparency, responsiveness, and a shared understanding of priorities and risks.

Preferred

- Solid knowledge and at least 3 years of experience of country-specific French/European Regulatory requirements for pharmacovigilance

- Knowledge of the compassionate use programs and releated regulatory requirements in France

- Experience in Quality Assurance and QA operational activities (e.g. managing deviations, changes, complaints, issues, recalls etc.), in managing third parties including auditing and contract management, in managing inspections by competent authorities

title: Staff Digital Product Designer – E-Commerce / Web Platform
description:
Staff Digital Product Designer – E-Commerce / Plateforme We 

Département : E-Commerce & Expérience Client / Équipe Web

Niveau : Leader Contributeur Individuel (Niveau Staff)

Lieu : Lille / Paris 

1. Contexte & Projet 

La raison d'être de Decathlon est de rassembler les gens autour du sport pour rendre le bien-être accessible à tous, guidant notre ambition globale de créer un Lien Humain Local et d'offrir des solutions sportives uniques et accessibles dans le monde entier. Dans ce contexte, notre objectif est de construire des expériences enrichies et personnalisées sur l'ensemble des points de contact numériques et des magasins physiques, en tirant parti du Digital, de la Data et de l'IA pour sublimer le parcours client global.

Le Défi E-Commerce Web 

En tant que porte d'entrée pour des millions de passionnés de sport à travers le monde, notre plateforme web (decathlon.country) doit transformer de manière fluide la curiosité en ligne en véritables expériences sportives. Notre défi est de métamorphoser un vaste magasin web multi-catégories en un portail numérique intuitif et sans friction.

Nous devons guider chaque utilisateur — qu'il s'agisse d'un premier visiteur à la recherche d'articles de sport ou d'un membre fidèle — tout au long d'un parcours fluide qui relie directement la navigation en ligne à la disponibilité en magasin local, au Click & Collect et aux services circulaires comme la location et la réparation.

En concevant une expérience web standardisée et modulaire, nous donnons aux équipes pays et aux partenaires franchisés internationaux des parcours d'achat pré-validés et à forte conversion, afin qu'ils puissent développer le commerce local sans effort et sans réinventer les parcours web fondamentaux.

Périmètre & Structure (4 Squads E-Com Dédiées) 

- Acquisition : Convertir les internautes en visiteurs actifs grâce à des pages d'atterrissage à forte conversion, au référencement (SEO), aux points d'entrée de campagne et à un accueil personnalisé du trafic.

- Navigation : Aider les utilisateurs à trouver exactement le produit ou le conseil dont ils ont besoin au sein d'un vaste catalogue grâce à une recherche intelligente, une taxonomie, des filtres et une hiérarchie de catalogue optimisés.

- Décision : Donner aux utilisateurs toutes les raisons convaincantes de choisir un produit en proposant des fiches produit (PDP) riches, des médias, des conseils de taille précis, des avis clients et des options durables/circulaires.

- Conversion : Offrir un processus de paiement sans friction, des moyens de paiement flexibles, le suivi de commande en autonomie, des options de retrait en magasin et des retours simplifiés.

2. Votre Mission 

En tant que Staff Digital Product Designer , vous intervenez en tant que contributeur individuel principal et leader stratégique au sein de l'équipe E-Commerce de Decathlon. En travaillant avec une grande autonomie sur des enjeux web complexes et inter-squads, vous façonnez notre vision stratégique à long terme : la 

Vision de l'Expérience Web E-Commerce .

Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration au sein du trio de leadership avec le Staff Engineering et les Staff Product Managers (GPMs) , tout en faisant équipe au quotidien avec un UX Researcher (UXR) dédié comme partenaire privilégie pour ancrer chaque décision de design dans des connaissances utilisateurs approfondies et des données quantitatives.

Au-delà de la définition de la stratégie, vous pilotez l' expérimentation terrain, la dé-risquage produit et les boucles de validation rapide — en veillant à ce que les fonctionnalités web majeures à travers les étapes d'Acquisition, Navigation, Décision et Conversion soient éprouvées par des tests A/B, de l'analyse CRO et des données d'utilisation réelles avant tout déploiement mondial. Vous alignez les 4 squads web autour d'une vision unifiée, accélérez la création de valeur commerciale et élevez la maturité du design au sein des équipes.

3. Vos Responsabilités

title: Senior Platform Engineer
description:
🌀 The Company

Founded in 2022, Filigran is a global cybersecurity company on a mission to empower defense teams to be proactive through open-source solutions that uncover threats and drive action. 

Filigran stands out in the cybersecurity ecosystem through its open-source, AI-powered and threat-informed approach to Continuous Threat Exposure Management (CTEM). Our eXtended Threat Management (XTM) platform brings together threat intelligence, exposure validation and cyber risk reduction, enabling organizations to better understand their threat landscape and take action.

At the heart of Filigran is our open-source approach. Our vision is to unite defenders into a global community to make security more open, resilient and collaborative.

As Filigran continues to scale globally, we are building the organization, infrastructure and capabilities needed for our next stage of growth. How we scale matters just as much as how fast we scale: our CORE values: Cohesion, Openness, Responsibility and Equity shape how we work together, make decisions and build for the future.

🎯 The Role

We're looking for a Senior Platform Engineer to join our Platform Engineering team and help us run, secure, and scale the infrastructure behind the XTM Platform , Filigran's open-source platform for agentic Continuous Threat Exposure Management (CTEM).

Our customer base keeps growing, in more regions and on more providers, and our platform grows with it: our own bare-metal Kubernetes cloud , the major public clouds , sovereign and regulated environments , and on-premises deployments for customers who run our products themselves.

You'll work across the whole platform, from Kubernetes clusters and deployment tooling to observability, security, and on-call, in a team that has made AI agents a core part of how it works .

💼 Your Responsibilities

- Design, build, and operate production Kubernetes clusters, on our own bare-metal infrastructure and on public clouds

- Roll out and operate Filigran products in new regions and on new providers as our SaaS footprint expands

- Develop and maintain the ways our products get deployed, by us and by our customers: Helm charts (including a major rework of our charts), Ansible automation, CI/CD pipelines, and a virtual appliance for on-premises environments

- Keep our SaaS instances available and reliable, and continuously improve how we run them: observability, monitoring, capacity planning, incident management, and post-incident reviews

- Harden the platform and help it meet the requirements of regulated environments (such as FedRAMP and SecNumCloud)

title: Head of Hardware
description:
Accelerating embodied AGI. 

The next ten years of AI will not be won in software. They will be won in the physical world: in factories, hospitals, kitchens, fields, and homes. The companies that own that data will own the century.

MicroAGI is building it. We are a data research and deployment lab. Atlas captures the manual work inside Europe’s industrial champions, trains foundation models on it, and deploys the right robot onto the floor, with no teleoperation and no interruption to the line. Shift records how physical work actually happens and turns it into training-ready data.

We were founded by former Formula 1 engineers from Red Bull Racing and Mercedes, together with a researcher from the Alan Turing Institute. Our $55M seed round, the largest in German history, was led by Hummingbird with Northzone, LocalGlobe, Village Global, and redalpine. We are based in Munich, with our research centre in Zürich and teams in London, New York, and Istanbul. We are now building the engineering and research teams that will take Atlas into new industries.

Our models learn from data captured in the physical world, by hardware we design and build ourselves. As Head of Hardware, you own that hardware end to end: electrical, firmware, and the mechanical integration that holds it together, from the first schematic to devices running on factory floors.

You lead the team that builds it. Today that is about six engineers on robotics, three on EMG sensing, and three on camera systems, plus contractors, and it will grow quickly. Our Electrical Engineer and Embedded Engineer roles report to you. You set the architecture they build against, and you still build alongside them.

This is a founder-shaped role, not a management seat. We are looking for someone who has carried a product from a blank page to customers with real skin in the game, wants to build both the thing and the team that builds it, and would rather design than review. If that sounds like you, you will want to do it again at the earliest stage.

What You Will Do

- Own the hardware roadmap for Shift and Atlas data capture: wearables, sensor rigs, camera systems, and prototype robots. What we build, in what order, and why.

- Set the system architecture across electrical, firmware, and mechanical: sensors, compute, power, wireless, and enclosures. Make the trade-offs, and make them stick when disciplines disagree.

- Stay on the bench: schematics, layout reviews, board bring-up, and a scope in your hands when the team is stuck. On the days it matters, you are the best electrical engineer in the room.

- Lead and grow the team: hire, set the bar, run design reviews, and give engineers ownership of whole subsystems rather than tickets.

- Guarantee data quality end to end: EMG and EEG front ends, camera pipelines, IMUs, and synchronization across many devices, so that what reaches the ML team is clean, time-aligned, and trustworthy.

- Take designs from prototype to small-batch production: DFM, component and EMS vendors, test fixtures, certification, and field reliability.

- Work shoulder to shoulder with ML and deployment. Your hardware decides what the training data looks like, and you will be on the floor where it is captured.

- Run contractors and partners without losing ownership of the result.

Requirements

- You have taken at least one product from zero to shipped, with significant ownership of the outcome: as a co-founder, CTO, first hardware hire, or the lead who owned the whole device. Not one subsystem, not one phase. Ideally a wearable, at a tier-one hardware company known for shipping at scale.

- Electrical engineering is your home discipline. You have designed boards that shipped, across mixed-signal, power, wireless, and high-speed digital, and you can still do it today.

- You think in systems. You understand how an electrode choice, an enclosure tolerance, and an ADC sample rate interact, and you can hold the mechanical and firmware conversations as a peer, not a customer.

- You have led engineers: hired them, grown them, and kept a team shipping through 0-to-1 ambiguity. Typically 6+ years in hardware, but we care more about what you shipped than how long it took.

- A strong understanding of how hardware decisions affect data quality. You know that a great model on a noisy signal still loses to a decent model on a clean one, and you design accordingly.

- Experience taking hardware to small-batch production: DFM, vendor and EMS management, test, and certification.

- Genuinely curious about ML: you read papers, you have trained at least one model end to end, and you understand that dataset quality beats model architecture choice.

- High agency: you don't wait to be told what to do. A 0-to-1 hardware program takes the hours it takes, in person and at pace, and you have chosen that before.

- Discreet: you handle confidential hardware roadmaps and customer data with care.

Nice to Have

- Wearables, smartwatches, drones, robotics, AR/VR, or defense wearables on your résumé.

- Camera systems: sensor selection, MIPI and ISP pipelines, and multi-camera synchronization.

- Low-power and battery design, BLE or Wi-Fi, and antenna integration in small enclosures.

- Enough mechanical fluency (CAD, tolerances, and materials) to challenge the mechanical team’s choices and be right some of the time.

- Prior founder or founding-engineer experience, including the parts that went wrong.

- Open-source hardware or firmware contributions.

Who Will Thrive at MicroAGI

Everyone we hire is assessed on the same four traits:

- Mission and vision: you care about what we are building and why it matters, and your past choices show it.

- Intensity: you work at a pace that matches the size of the opportunity, and you sustain it.

- Entrepreneurial: you start things nobody asked for, and you finish them.

- Raw IQ: you learn fast, reason from first principles, and get sharper when the problem changes.

This is for you if: 

- You would rather own a problem end to end than wait for a spec.

- You use AI every day, and you can tell a correct answer from a plausible one.

- You want to work in person, in the office, with people who are very good at what they do.

This is not for you if: 

- You are looking for a predictable 9-to-5.

- You would forward output you cannot explain.

- "That’s not my job" feels like a reasonable answer.

How We Hire

We read every application and reply within five working days.

- Talent Screen (30 min): a first conversation, both ways.

- Technical or Functional Interview (60 min): how you think when the problem changes.

- Your Work (60 min): bring something you are proud of and walk us through it.

- Leadership (30 min): a conversation with our CEO.

- Coworking Day (engineering and research roles): a day building with the team on a real problem.

Then a decision, usually within a few days.

Pay Transparency

Compensation includes base salary and equity. The salary range for this role is shown on this posting.

What We Offer

- Agency: real ownership from day one, and decisions that actually matter.

- Freedom: to choose how you solve the problem, without layers of approval.

- A seat on a rocketship: one of Europe’s fastest-growing deep-tech companies, at the earliest stage.

- Free food and drinks in the office.

Equal Opportunity

MicroAGI welcomes applications from everyone. We assess candidates on their work and potential, regardless of ethnic origin, gender, religion or belief, disability, age, or sexual identity.

As Founders Associate in our office in Zurich, you'll be the right hand of our CTO, Max. You run the daily business of the CTO office, own strategic projects from start to finish, drive the first round of our technical hiring, and bridge technology and business. This is a true zero-to-one mandate.

- Exposure to AI, cloud or GPU infrastructure

Why us? 

- Outstanding team: Work with some of the best engineers in the world, coming from hedge funds, big tech, AI startups and top universities

- Once in a lifetime opportunity: Early-stage company in the fastest-growing market in the world

Proteins are the molecular machines of life, used for many therapeutic, diagnostic, chemical, agricultural and food applications. Designing and optimizing proteins takes a lot of expert knowledge and manual effort, through the use of custom computational and biological tools.

We offer our employees a very competitive salary, a generous equity stake in the company and a wide range of benefits and career progression opportunities.

The Role 

As Executive Assistant at Cradle, you'll keep two of our founding executives moving. Between customer visits, investor meetings, hiring and travel across Amsterdam, Zurich and the US, there's a lot to keep track of, and your job is to make sure nothing gets dropped. You'll own their calendars, inboxes and travel, and take care of the personal admin that would otherwise eat into their time. This role suits someone who likes being trusted with the whole picture, professional and personal, and treats both with the same care.

Responsibilities 

- Run two calendars as one system: Protect focus time, balance competing priorities across time zones, and decide what deserves a meeting and what can be an email.

- Plan travel end to end: Customer visits, conferences and trips between Amsterdam, Zurich and the US, from flights and hotels to the meeting room and dinner booking on the other side.

- Take care of personal and life admin: Appointments, household logistics, official paperwork, bills and renewals, handled so none of it lands on their desks.

- Prepare every important meeting: Make sure briefs and context are ready beforehand, and follow up on decisions and action items afterwards.

- Make recurring admin disappear: Automate repeated processes so they mostly run themselves.

Requirements

- 4+ years supporting senior executives, ideally more than one at a time

- Sharp judgment about what's urgent, what can wait and what never needs to reach the exec

- You spot the next problem before anyone asks and fix it

- Experience handling personal admin alongside the professional side, with the discretion that comes with it

- Organised and dependable without needing a rigid structure; at a ~90-person company you'll often build the process yourself

- At home in Google Workspace and quick to pick up new software tools

Nice to Haves

- German fluency would be idea to would make local appointments, paperwork and authorities much easier

- Familiarity with Swiss administrative procedures (permits, insurance, tax paperwork, relocations)

Sereact is a Series B embodied-AI company. Cortex, our VLA model, is deployed in live warehouse robotic cells across the EU and US. Zurich is our newest research hub, focused on the manipulation and control problems that sit underneath Cortex.

The role

This is a Research Engineer position. It is scoped to the data generation layer of the VLA stack: teleoperation hardware and software, retargeting pipelines that map human demonstrations onto robot hands, and the data collection infrastructure that feeds Cortex. - Build and operate teleoperation systems for dexterous manipulation, including retargeting algorithms that map human hand and arm motion onto robot end-effectors

What you'll bring

- MSc (or equivalent, in progress) in robotics, mechanical engineering, or a closely related field, with a thesis or capstone project on manipulation, teleoperation, or retargeting

- Hands-on experience building a data collection device or system for robot learning (UMI or a comparable system), not just operating one someone else built

Nice to have

- A conference submission on manipulation, teleoperation, or retargeting where the candidate is an author (an MSc thesis submitted to a venue like CoRL counts; supervising a student team whose own work was later published does not)

title: (Junior) Campaign Manager (m/w/d) – remote
description:
Deine Rolle Die Stelle ist zunächst auf ein Jahr befristet. Uns ist eine langfristige Zusammenarbeit wichtig, daher ist eine Übernahme in eine unbefristete Anstellung angestrebt.

Als Campaign Manager*in bist du das Herzstück unserer Kundenprojekte: Du verbindest kreatives Marketing, strategische Beratung und operative Exzellenz, um Top-Brands und Arbeitgeber perfekt auf unserer Plattform und Social Media zu inszenieren. Dabei bist du für folgende Themenschwerpunkte verantwortlich:
- End-to-End Kampagnensteuerung: Du planst, betreust und wickelst Werbekampagnen für unsere Kunden und Agenturen ab. Von der ersten Idee bis zur finalen Umsetzung hast du das Heft fest in der Hand.
- Multichannel-Setup & Operations: Du setzt Kampagnen zeitgerecht in unseren eigenen Inhouse-Tools sowie auf Social Media um und managst flexibel Umbuchungen oder Stornierungen.
- Employer Branding & Jobbörse: Du betreust Employer-Branding-Kampagnen unserer Partner, legst zielgruppenstarke Stellenanzeigen an und verwaltest diese passgenau auf unserer StudySmarter Jobbörse, um Arbeitgeber optimal bei der Gen Z zu positionieren.
- Kreativ-Workflows & Design-Beratung: Du berätst unsere Kunden zur visuellen Gestaltung und Zielgruppenansprache, erstellst Mailings und baust ansprechende Kundenprofile auf.
- Sales-Schnittstelle & Support: Du arbeitest eng mit dem Sales-Team zusammen, bildest die Schnittstelle zu allen vertriebsrelevanten Bereichen und unterstützt aktiv bei der Weiterentwicklung von Marketing- und Vertriebsaktionen.
- Data-driven After-Sales: Du analysierst die Kampagnen-Performance, erstellst aussagekräftige Reportings und präsentierst die Ergebnisse überzeugend vor unseren Kunden.

Was du für diese Rolle brauchst - Background: Idealerweise hast du erste praktische Erfahrung im Online-Marketing, einer (Media-)Agentur, im HR-Marketing/Employer Branding oder einem vergleichbaren Umfeld – auch motivierte Quereinsteiger*innen sind bei uns herzlich willkommen!
- Kommunikationsstärke: Verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse sowie echte Freude am direkten, beratenden Kundenkontakt.
- Organisationstalent: Ein hervorragendes Zeitmanagement, eine strukturierte Arbeitsweise und die Fähigkeit, in dynamischen Phasen die richtigen Prioritäten zu setzen.
- Markengespür & Kundenfokus: Ein geschultes Auge für gutes Design, Kreativität und ein tiefes Verständnis für die unterschiedlichen B2B-Kundenbedürfnisse.
- Mindset: Hohe Eigenmotivation, der Wille zur persönlichen Weiterentwicklung und die Leidenschaft, ein stark wachsendes EdTech-Unternehmen mit der Vision „Besseres Lernen für alle“ aktiv mitzugestalten.
- Sprachen: Du sprichst absolut fließend Deutsch und kannst dich auf Englisch gut verständigen.

Warum StudySmarter? Wir sind längst mehr als eine Lern-App - StudySmarter begleitet Millionen Menschen von der Schule über das Studium bis in den Berufseinstieg. Dabei bewegen wir uns an der Schnittstelle aus Tech, Social Impact und internationalem Wachstum: Wir setzen früh auf neue Technologien, insbesondere KI, und entwickeln Produkt und Prozesse kontinuierlich weiter. Du bist Teil eines Teams, das diesen Anspruch jeden Tag in die Praxis übersetzt. 

Was du bei uns findest: 

- Remote-first: Arbeite von dort, wo du am produktivsten bist! 

- Ownership statt Mikromanagement: Kurze Wege zum Founder-Team, echte Entscheidungsbefugnis, kein Wasserkopf. 

- Beteiligung am Erfolg: Du wirst am Unternehmenserfolg von StudySmarter beteiligt (Shares). 

- Gesundheit: Firmenrabatt über EGYM Wellpass für dein Training. 

- Team & Kultur: Regelmäßige Teamevents und Ausflüge, ein diverses und ambitioniertes Team. 

- Modernes Büro in München: Hochwertige Ausstattung, Terrasse – falls du doch mal vor Ort sein möchtest. 

- Verpflegung: Frisches Obst, Säfte, Porridge-Bar und eine Getränke-Flatrate im Büro. 

- Ausstattung & Weiterbildung: Wähl dein eigenes Arbeitsequipment, und wir unterstützen dich aktiv bei Schulungen und Weiterbildungen 

Deine Bewerbung Schick uns Deinen CV. Ein Anschreiben ist optional.

Wir freuen uns über jede Bewerbung und melden uns so schnell wie möglich bei Dir zurück.

title: Senior Software Developer (m/w/d) ELMI AI Plattform (Berlin/Bonn/Frankfurt)
description:
Baue die Softwareplattform, die unsere Ladeinfrastruktur intelligent macht! 

ELMI Power entwickelt und vertreibt batteriegestützte DC-Schnellladestationen und Batteriespeichersysteme. Mit ELMI AI bauen wir jetzt die softwareseitige Ergänzung dazu auf: eine Plattform, die unsere Ladestationen und Batteriespeicher intelligent steuert – sie liest und verarbeitet Daten aus dem Energiemanagementsystem, analysiert Preise umliegender Ladestationen und passt die eigene Preisgestaltung dynamisch an, optimiert Nachladestrategien der internen Batterie und betreibt aktiven Energiehandel. Ein Produktmanager ist bereits an Bord, erste Modul-Prototypen (MVP) existieren – jetzt geht es darum, daraus ein robustes, produktionsreifes Softwareprodukt zu bauen.

Du bist erfahrener Software Engineer mit Architektur-Know-how, hast schon mit AWS-Infrastruktur gearbeitet – und willst selbst coden und Verantwortung für deine Module übernehmen? Du willst ein Produkt von der ersten stabilen Version an mitgestalten, statt in einem gewachsenen System nur zu verwalten? Dann bist du bei uns richtig.

Aufgaben

Deine Mission – Unsere gemeinsame Reise 

- Produktarchitektur & AWS-Infrastruktur: Mitgestaltung und Aufbau einer skalierbaren Cloud-Architektur auf AWS für die ELMI-AI-Plattform.

- Von MVP zu Produktionsreife: Bewertung, Weiterentwicklung und teilweiser Neuaufbau bestehender Modul-Prototypen zu einer stabilen, ersten produktiven Version.

- EMS-Datenintegration: Anbindung und Verarbeitung von Daten aus den Energiemanagementsystemen unserer Ladestationen und Batteriespeicher.

- Dynamische Preisgestaltung: Technische Umsetzung der Marktanalyse umliegender Ladestationen und automatisierter, dynamischer Preisanpassung.

- Ladestrategie-Optimierung: Entwicklung von Logik und Algorithmen zur Optimierung der Nachladestrategie interner Batteriespeicher.

- Energiehandel: Technische Umsetzung von Schnittstellen und Handelslogik für den automatisierten Energiehandel.

- Zusammenarbeit im Team: Enge Zusammenarbeit mit dem Entwicklerteam (u. a. Nearshore-Team), inklusive Code Reviews und Mitwirkung an Technologieentscheidungen.

- Hands-on Coding: Aktive Entwicklung im Code, insbesondere in der kritischen Aufbauphase der ersten stabilen Version.

Qualifikation

Dein Profil – Unser Match 

- Erfahrung: Mehrjährige Erfahrung als Software Engineer, idealerweise mit Aufbau eines Softwareprodukts von einer frühen Phase an.

- AWS & Cloud-Architektur: Nachgewiesene Erfahrung im Aufbau und Betrieb von AWS-Infrastruktur.

- Hands-on-Mentalität: Du codest gerne selbst und übernimmst Verantwortung für deine Themen von der Konzeption bis zum Betrieb.

- Plattform-/IoT-Erfahrung: Erfahrung mit Software, die verteilte, physische Assets steuert (z. B. IoT-Plattformen, Fleet- oder Asset-Management, Smart Grid). Erfahrung mit Ladeinfrastruktur, EMS oder Energiehandel ist ein Plus, aber kein Muss.

- Teamarbeit: Erfahrung in der Zusammenarbeit mit (Remote-/Nearshore-)Entwicklerteams; du teilst gerne dein Wissen mit weniger erfahrenen Kolleg:innen.

- Pragmatismus: Du triffst technische Entscheidungen, die zur aktuellen Unternehmensgröße passen, statt Over-Engineering zu betreiben.

- Sprachkenntnisse: Fließendes Deutsch und sehr gutes Englisch für die Zusammenarbeit mit dem internationalen Team. Wenn du Kenntnisse in Mandarin hast, ist das ein großes Plus.

Benefits

Unsere Vorteile – Deine Perspektiven 

- Wachstumspfad: Du baust mit ELMI AI ein komplett neues Geschäftsfeld mit auf – mit dem Produkt wächst auch deine Rolle und Verantwortung, bis hin zu einer möglichen Head-Perspektive.

- Technisch spannendes Umfeld: Moderne AWS-Cloud-Architektur, Echtzeitdaten aus dem Feld, dynamische Preismodelle und Energiehandel – eine der technisch spannendsten Schnittstellen der Energiewende.

- Echte Verantwortung ab Tag 1: Du entscheidest über Architektur, Tech-Stack und den Aufbau des Entwicklerteams.

- Kurze Entscheidungswege: Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Geschäftsführung und Produktmanagement – kein Konzerndenken, kein Silo.

Jetzt bist du dran! 

Klingt nach dir? Dann werde Teil des Teams, das die Software für die Ladeinfrastruktur von morgen baut – und präge ELMI AI von der ersten Zeile Code an.

Sende uns deine Unterlagen zu – wir freuen uns darauf, mit dir zu besprechen, wie deine Rolle bei ELMI AI aussehen kann. Start: zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt. Vergütung: verhandelbar, je nach Erfahrung.

Wir freuen uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen und gemeinsam mit dir ELMI AI aufzubauen!

Bewirb dich jetzt – und baue die Intelligenz hinter unserer Ladeinfrastruktur! 

Arbeite an einem unserer Standorte in Berlin, Bonn oder in Niddatal bei Frankfurt

title: Head of Finance & Controlling
description:
Wir suchen dich als

Head of Finance & Controlling (all genders) – für eine Rolle, in der du eine verlässliche Finance-Basis mit vorausschauendem Controlling und fundierten Entscheidungsgrundlagen für unser Business verbindest.

Aufgaben

- Finance & Accounting: Du verantwortest unsere Finance- und Accounting-Prozesse und stellst gemeinsam mit unserer operativen Buchhaltung und externen Partnern eine verlässliche Finanzbuchhaltung sowie saubere Monats-, Quartals- und Jahresabschlussprozesse sicher.

- Controlling & Forecasting: Du entwickelst Budgetierung, Forecasting und Plan-/Ist-Analysen weiter und sorgst dafür, dass wir Entwicklungen bei Umsatz, Kosten, Cash und Profitabilität frühzeitig erkennen.

- Management Reporting: Du entwickelst unser Reporting und unsere KPIs weiter und bereitest Zahlen so auf, dass daraus klare Zusammenhänge, Risiken und Handlungsoptionen entstehen.

- Finance Business Partnering: Du arbeitest eng mit unseren Executives und Teamleads zusammen, unterstützt bei Business Cases, Investitionen und Ressourcenentscheidungen und challengest Annahmen, wenn Zahlen und Erwartungen nicht zusammenpassen.

- Commercial Finance: Du verbindest unsere Sales Pipeline mit Umsatzplanung und Financial Forecast und arbeitest mit Sales und Customer Solutions an einer realistischen Einordnung von Chancen, Revenue und wirtschaftlicher Entwicklung.

- Performance & Efficiency: Du unterstützt dabei, wirtschaftliche Verantwortung stärker in unseren Teams zu verankern und begleitest Initiativen rund um Umsatzsteigerung, Kosteneffizienz und messbaren P&L-Impact.

- Du koordinierst unsere Finanzprozesse für Deutschland, die USA und Singapur und entwickelst die internationalen Strukturen kontinuierlich weiter. Dabei arbeitest du auch eng mit den lokalen Steuerberatern und externen Experten.Daten, Systeme & Automatisierung: Du entwickelst unsere Finance- und Reportingprozesse weiter, verbindest relevante Datenquellen und nutzt künstliche Intelligenze sowie branchenstandards wie z.B. Power BI, Excel und weitere Systeme, um Transparenz zu erhöhen und manuelle Arbeit zu eleminieren. Dabei steht Dir auch ein Budget für die Einführung eines ERP-Systems zur Verfügung.

- Leadership: Du führst unsere Kollegin im operativen Accounting und entwickelst gemeinsam mit ihr klare Verantwortlichkeiten, Prozesse und Standards innerhalb von Finance weiter.

- Sehr gute Erfahrung in Controlling, Budgetierung, Forecasting, Management Reporting und der wirtschaftlichen Bewertung von Entscheidungen.

- Ein ausgeprägtes Business-Verständnis und Erfahrung darin, Führungskräfte als Finance Business Partner zu beraten und konstruktiv zu challengen.

Benefits

- Starker Teamzusammenhalt - Arbeite mit Kolleginnen und Kollegen zusammen, die Teamarbeit nicht nur leben, sondern auch Spaß daran haben und sich gegenseitig unterstützen.

title: Senior Data Engineer (Full-time)
description:
Pregnancy, childbirth, and early parenthood bring about a lot of changes. And with each phase, new questions arise: small ones, big ones, practical ones, emotional ones. Glimmer helps to see more clearly what's happening right now, what's important, and what's right.

We combine in-depth expert knowledge, a digital midwife consultation service, and practical tips in one app. This way, customers will find reliable answers, prenatal and postpartum recovery classes, and support all in one place. Accessible, compassionate, and tailored.

Glimmer is covered by over 80 health insurance providers and supports customers from their child's first heartbeat to their first steps. So they can navigate this journey with greater clarity, confidence, and peace of mind.

Glimmer is a Berlin-based start-up with around 40 employees. As our Senior Data Engineer, you'll be part of the Data & Engineering team and play a key role in building the data foundations that help us turn insight into better care for every family we support.

Tasks

Role Overview: 

We're looking for a motivated and highly autonomous Data Engineer to build and own the foundations of our data platform. You'll enjoy this role if you like ownership, can design reliable and scalable data pipelines, and care about giving every team clean, trustworthy data. You'll also be handling sensitive health data, so we need someone who treats privacy and security as core engineering principles.

What Success Looks Like:

Over the last seven years, and through several acquisitions, our data landscape has grown into a patchwork of systems, pipelines and workarounds. Your biggest impact will be replacing that complexity with a single, modern data warehouse and a platform that is simple, well documented and easy to build on.

In practice, success means: 

- Within your first 3 months: You've mapped our current data landscape, including legacy systems, inherited sources from acquisitions, pipelines and dependencies, and you've shared a clear target architecture and migration plan that the team supports.

- Within 6 months: The foundations of the new data warehouse are live, the most important data sources are migrated, and the first legacy pipelines and tools have been retired.

- Within 12 months: The new warehouse is our single source of truth. Redundant systems are gone, core metrics are defined consistently across the business, and teams trust the data without double-checking it.

- Throughout: Data is easier to find, understand and use. Onboarding a new source or answering a new question takes days, not weeks, and the platform is documented well enough that it doesn't depend on any one person.

What You'll Do: 

- Design, build and maintain scalable ETL/ELT pipelines using SQL, Python and PostgreSQL

- Own and evolve our cloud data infrastructure on AWS (primarily EC2 & RDS), balancing performance, reliability, security and cost.

- Own the end-to-end engineering of our automated insurance invoicing pipeline, so that reimbursement, claim status and financial data flow accurately and reliably into downstream systems

- Build and maintain ingestion pipelines that connect product, web, CRM and advertising platforms (e.g. Amplitude, Meta, Google Ads, HubSpot) into a unified data model

- Develop and maintain integrations with internal and external tools and SaaS products via REST APIs

- Design and implement data models and warehouse schemas that support business reporting, product analytics, experimentation and regulatory requirements

- Put data quality, testing, monitoring and alerting in place so problems are caught before they reach stakeholders

- Orchestrate and automate workflows, and apply software engineering best practices (version control, CI/CD, code review, documentation)

- Make sure data is handled in line with GDPR, health data privacy requirements, and internal policies, including access control, pseudonymisation and retention policies

- Work closely with Marketing, Product and Finance to understand their data needs and deliver datasets that feed tools such as AWS Quicksight

- Share knowledge and coach team members on data concepts, tooling and best practices

Requirements

Your Profile: 

- 3+ years' experience in Data Engineering or a closely related role, ideally in a startup or scale-up

- Strong hands-on skills in SQL, Python, PostgreSQL and AWS (EC2/RDS)

- A track record of building and owning data pipelines and warehouse architectures from scratch in fast-moving environments

- Experience with API integrations, workflow automation and version control (GitHub)

- Solid understanding of data modelling, data quality practices and pipeline observability

- Awareness of data privacy and security, ideally with experience handling sensitive or regulated data (GDPR)

- Nice to have: experience with orchestration tools (e.g. Airflow, Dagster), transformation frameworks (e.g. dbt), infrastructure as code, or BI tools like AWS Quicksight

- A high degree of autonomy, curiosity and ownership

- Fluent in English, German is a plus

Benefits

Why Glimmer 

- Real Ownership from Day 1: You'll own the architecture and foundations of our data platform, not just execute a roadmap, but shape it.

- Growth Through Challenge, Not Stagnation: You'll build deep expertise in modern data architecture, regulated health data handling, and cross-functional platform ownership, while coaching others along the way.

- Close to the Business: You'll work closely with Marketing, Product and Finance, seeing firsthand how clean, trustworthy data shapes real decisions across the company.

- Purpose: You're building the data backbone for a digital health platform that supports women and families through pregnancy, birth and early parenthood.

- Mentoring & Team Culture: You'll be part of a motivated, diverse team that shares knowledge and supports each other.

- Community: Regular team breakfasts and fixed celebrations throughout the year keep the team connected.

- Work-Life & Perks: 30 days of paid vacation, an Urban Sports Club membership and 3 months remote work allowance are waiting for you.

Our Hiring Process 

- Screening Call (15 min) A quick intro to get to know each other.

- First Interview (45 min) A deeper conversation about your experience and the role.

- Case Study (4 hours) A practical task that reflects the kind of work you'd be doing with us.

- Case Study Interview (1.5 hours) We'll walk through your solution together.

- Final Round (1 hour) Meet the team and get a feel for how we work.
